resources.string: This app is locked. Enter the passcode from your accountability partner to unlock.
Wrong passcode. Your partner has been notified.

Kempt uses device administrator access only to make itself harder to uninstall while a lock is active. It cannot wipe your device, change your screen lock, or read your data. You can turn it off in Kempt anytime a lock is not active.
Turning off uninstall protection will be reported to your accountability partner.
